import sys, json, time, heapq, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo, topo
prof = json.load(open('/tmp/bigprof.json'))
fab = json.load(open('/tmp/bigfab.json'))
cal = para.calibrate(prof)
F = topo.Fabric(fab)
H,_ = para.hop_tables(cal['upper_ps'], prof['jitter_ps'])
F.build_edges(H)
ip,dst,w,_k = F.csr(0)
srcs = F.anchor_states.tolist()
nst = F.nstates
INF = topo.INF

def v1(nst, ip, dst, w, srcs):
    dist=[INF]*nst; heap=[]
    for s in srcs: dist[s]=0; heap.append((0,s))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push=heapq.heappush; pop=heapq.heappop
    while heap:
        d,u = pop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]: continue
        for j in range(ip[u], ip[u+1]):
            v = dst[j]
            nd = d + w[j]
            if nd < dist[v]:
                dist[v]=nd; push(heap,(nd,v))
    return dist

def v2(nst, ip, dst, w, srcs):
    dist=[INF]*nst; heap=[]
    for s in srcs: dist[s]=0; heap.append((0,s))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push=heapq.heappush; pop=heapq.heappop
    while heap:
        d,u = pop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]: continue
        for vv, ww in zip(dst[ip[u]:ip[u+1]], w[ip[u]:ip[u+1]]):
            nd = d + ww
            if nd < dist[vv]:
                dist[vv]=nd; push(heap,(nd,vv))
    return dist

def v3(nst, ip, dst, w, srcs):
    # interleaved flat array
    flat=[]
    for u in range(nst):
        for j in range(ip[u], ip[u+1]):
            flat.append(dst[j]); flat.append(w[j])
    dist=[INF]*nst; heap=[]
    for s in srcs: dist[s]=0; heap.append((0,s))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push=heapq.heappush; pop=heapq.heappop
    while heap:
        d,u = pop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]: continue
        b=2*ip[u]; e=2*ip[u+1]
        for j in range(b,e,2):
            v = flat[j]
            nd = d + flat[j+1]
            if nd < dist[v]:
                dist[v]=nd; push(heap,(nd,v))
    return dist

for name, fn in (('v1',v1),('v2',v2),('v3',v3)):
    t0=time.time(); d=fn(nst,ip,dst,w,srcs); print(name, round(time.time()-t0,3), d[:3])
EOF
